Lessons: Birth and Early Years; Baptism and Temptation; Teachings and Parables; Miracles and Compassion; The Last Week in Jerusalem; The Cross; The Resurrection and Ascension
Description: Come and walk with Jesus through the Gospels, step by step. You will meet Him in His teachings, His miracles and His compassion for ordinary people, and see why His death and resurrection change everything. It is a warm invitation to know Him better, not just know about Him.
